description:
Thorough test coverage using deterministic simulation + property-based testing.

## Testing Architecture

Three layers:
1. Unit tests — pure logic (buffer management, option parsing)
2. Simulation tests — GenServer against the Simulator transport
3. Integration tests — GenServer against real ts_elixir (optional, CI needs headscale)

## Simulation Property Tests (core of the test suite)

Use StreamData to generate:
  - Random sequences of operations: send, recv, setopts, controlling_process, close
  - Random fault schedules: partial reads, drops, delays, connection failures
  - Random data: arbitrary binaries of various sizes
  - Random active mode transitions: false → once → N → true → false

Invariants to verify (safety properties):
  - Data integrity: bytes sent == bytes received, in order, no duplication
  - Recv length: recv(socket, n) returns exactly n bytes (or error)
  - Active mode delivery: all data delivered as messages, in order
  - Controlling process: messages always go to current owner
  - Close semantics: no messages/replies after close
  - Option round-trip: getopts returns what setopts set

Liveness properties (TigerBeetle-style):
  - After faults heal, pending recv eventually completes
  - After faults heal, active mode eventually delivers buffered data
  - After controlling_process, new owner eventually receives

## Deterministic Replay

Every test run logs its seed. On failure:
  - Print seed for reproduction
  - Replay with same seed produces identical execution
  - Simulator logs full event trace for debugging

## Reference

- sled.rs/simulation.html — transport behaviour separation
- TigerBeetle VOPR — safety then liveness testing
- OTP gen_tcp_SUITE.erl — applicable test cases for compatibility
